model = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained("prism-ml/Ternary-Bonsai-2-27B-gguf", device_map="auto")
tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained("prism-ml/Ternary-Bonsai-2-27B-gguf")
